data.name: Nasira
data.gender_notes: Nasira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nasira is an Arabic name that means 'protector' or 'defender'. It is a strong and courageous name that symbolizes protection and safety. The name Nasira carries the meaning “Protector, Defender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasira usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, defender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nasira is associated with the concept of 'nasr', which means divine support and victory.
data.etymology: Nasira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Defender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasira total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ناصرة
in_arabic.meaning: إسم يعني الفتاة المحمودة، الشخصية الرائعة والقوية، السيدة المباركة، الشخصية النافعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: ناصرة من أسماء الله الحسنى، تعني الشخصية الرائعة والقوية، السيدة المباركة، الشخصية النافعة، تعود أصل الاسم إلى الكلمة العربية "نصير"، التي تعني "المناصر" أو "المؤيد". في القرآن الكريم، يُذكَر اسم "ناصرة" في سورة الأعراف، آية 112، حيث يُقال: "ناصرةً لا ناصرةً"، مما يعني "أصحاب المناصرة" أو "أصحاب المؤيد". في التراث الإسلامي، يتم استخدام اسم "ناصرة" لوصف الشخصيات الرائعة والقوية الذين يعملون كمناصرة لمساعدة الآخرين. في العصر الحديث، يُعتبر اسم "ناصرة" إحدى أشهر الأسماء الإسلامية المُستخدمة في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ناصرة
in_urdu.meaning: اسم سے تعبیر ہے جو ایک بہترین، مضبوط، اور نافع خاتون کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ناصرة ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو ناصِر کا مشتق ہے۔ یہ نام ایک بہترین، مضبوط، اور نافع خاتون کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ ناصرة سے مراد ایک خاتون ہے جو اپنے گھر اور خاندان کی حمایت اور مدد کے لئے مشہور ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن میں سورة الاعراف کی آیت 112 میں مذکور ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नासिरा
in_hindi.meaning: नाम से यह अर्थ है एक उत्तम, सशक्त और लाभकारी महिला
in_hindi.long_meaning: नासिरा एक इस्लामी नाम है जो नासिर का विकास है। यह नाम एक उत्तम, सशक्त और लाभकारी महिला की पुकार है। नासिरा से तात्पर्य एक महिला है जो अपने घर और परिवार की सहायता और समर्थन के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। यह नाम कुरान में सूरा अल-अराफ की आयत 112 में वर्णित है।

in_pashto.name: ناصره
in_pashto.meaning: ګړي په کلمې دا ښایي چي هغه ښځه څښتنې، په قوي، د خپل کورنۍ او کورنیو لپاره چمتو وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: ناصره يو اسلامي نوم دی چې د ناصره کلمې له مخې دی. دا نوم يو ښځه څښتنې، په قوي، د خپل کورنۍ او کورنیو لپاره چمتو والی ښځه ښایي چي په معنا سره دی. ناصره يو نوم دی چې په قرآن کې سورة العراف کې د 112 آیت ته رسيږي. دا نوم د ناصره کلمې له مخې دی چې د ښځو لپاره ښایي د ناصره کلمې په معنا سره دی.

in_english.name: Nasira
in_english.meaning: a name meaning a praiseworthy, strong, and beneficial woman, a virtuous and noble lady
in_english.long_meaning: Nasira is an Islamic name derived from the Arabic root "n-s-r" meaning 'to assist' or 'to support'. In the Quran, the name Nasira is mentioned in Surah Al-Araf, Verse 112, where it states "Nasira" to denote 'those who assist' or 'those who support'. Historically, the name Nasira has been used to describe women who are strong and virtuous, and who work to support and assist others. In modern times, the name Nasira has become a popular choice among Muslims, symbolizing a praiseworthy, strong, and beneficial woman, a virtuous and noble lady.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nasira holds significant cultural importance in various Islamic societies. The name Nasira is also associated with the concept of protection and defense, which is a central theme in Islamic history and tradition. For instance, in various Islamic texts and stories, there are numerous characters who take on the role of a protector or defender, such as the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who defended the Islamic community in Medina from its enemies, or the various martyrs and heroes who gave their lives to protect their people and their faith. The name Nasira can therefore be seen as a reminder of the importance of courage, resilience, and protection in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Nasira lies in its association with protection and defense on a deeper, spiritual level. In Islamic belief, every believer has a guardian angel or protector (Hafiz) who shields them from harm and guides them towards the path of righteousness. The name Nasira can therefore be seen as a reflection of this divine protection and guidance. It is a reminder that no matter what challenges or hardships one may face in life, they are never alone, and that God is always with them, protecting and guiding them. The name Nasira can also be seen as a call to action for individuals to become protectors and defenders of their own spiritual well-being, and the well-being of their communities and the wider world. It is a reminder of the importance of upholding the values of truth, justice, and compassion, and of working towards creating a better world for all.
